<thought>We need to retrieve polymorph data for a set of nitride compositions (up to 40). I will use a representative list of common nitride formulas. Then we will consolidate the retrieved JSON files, prepare a tabular dataset, train an XGBoost model with the specified hyperparameters, evaluate it on the test set, perform 5‑fold cross‑validation, and finally write the required metrics to a JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
